name: Leaked Credential and Threat-Intel Sign-In
description: Microsoft compares sign-ins against known leaked password lists, malware-related IP addresses, and its own threat intelligence. A match means that password or that network has already been seen in a breach or a botnet. The login might still succeed if MFA is off. Treat these as 'assume the password is public' and force a reset, even if the user says they were in the office.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
